_comment_file: The vault surfaces: choosing a vault, creating one, the recovery key, and unlocking. This is the first thing a new user reads and the last thing a locked-out one reads, so it carries more security-critical copy than any other namespace. Anything marked SECURITY-CRITICAL describes permanent, unrecoverable data loss; softening it into something gentler is a foreseeable source of harm, and those strings get a second reader before a translation is accepted (docs/features/i18n.md).

probe._comment_reading: The cleartext header of the vault file is being read. Nothing is decrypted at this point — say 'header', not 'vault'.

kdf._comment_: Argon2id key derivation takes about a second by design. Shown beside the spinner on every screen that derives a key — creating a vault, unlocking one, adding or rotating a key slot. It is an explanation of a security property, not an apology for a slow program: do not turn 'deliberately slow' into 'this may take a moment'.
kdf.slow: اشتقاق المفتاح بطيء عن قصد. هذه التكلفة هي ما يجعل مهاجمة ملف خزنة مسروق باهظة.
kdf._comment_slowWithSummary: {summary} is the cost this vault was written with, e.g. 'Argon2id, 256 MiB, t=3'. It is produced by the core and is never translated.
kdf.slowWithSummary: اشتقاق المفتاح بطيء عن قصد — {summary}. هذه التكلفة هي ما يجعل مهاجمة ملف خزنة مسروق باهظة.

keyfile._comment_: A key file is a second factor: any file the user chooses becomes part of the key. These strings are shared by the unlock screen, the create wizard and the vault-settings dialogs.
keyfile.label: ملف المفتاح
keyfile._comment_filterKeyfile: The name of a file-type filter in the operating system's file dialog. 'Remoter' is the product name and is never translated; 'key file' is.
keyfile._comment_filterAll: The second filter in the same dialog. It exists because ANY file can be a key file, so the wording must not suggest a restriction.
keyfile._comment_blockedIsVault: Why the primary button will not respond. Shown beside it. The mistake it prevents is real: the file dialog opens on the vault's own folder, and choosing the vault produces a lock-out whose only message is 'That did not unlock the vault.'
keyfile.blockedIsVault: لا يصلح هذا الملف ليكون ملف المفتاح لهذه الخزنة.

refusal._comment_: SECURITY-CRITICAL. Stated as certainties rather than warnings: none of these files can ever be a key file, and letting one through produces a lock-out that nobody can diagnose afterwards. {name} is a file name — user data, in any script, wrapped in a Unicode isolate before it arrives.
refusal.isTheVault: {name} هو ملف الخزنة نفسه، لا ملف مفتاحها. اختر ملفًا آخر.
refusal.isAVault: {name} خزنة Remoter، وليس ملف مفتاح. اختر ملفًا آخر.
refusal.isABackup: {name} نسخة احتياطية متعاقبة من خزنة، وليس ملف مفتاح. اختر ملفًا آخر.

slot._comment_: The four ways a vault can be opened, named on the unlock screen's cards. Each is a noun phrase, not a verb: they name a method, they are not an instruction to use it.
slot._comment_keychain: The system keychain (Keychain on macOS, Secret Service on Linux, Credential Manager on Windows) is holding the key for this machine. Phrased from the user's side: they asked to be remembered.

picker._comment_: The launch screen. It lists the vaults this machine has opened before; nothing on it decrypts anything.
picker.title: فتح خزنة
picker.lede: لا يُفك تشفير أي شيء حتى تفتح قفل إحداها.
picker._comment_unreachable: Why a remembered vault cannot be opened. The core sends a stable kind ("missing", "unreadable", "not-a-file") and the values; these are the sentences it sends them for. {path} is the vault's file path and {detail} is the operating system's own error text: neither is translated, and both are inserted as data, so a brace or a bracket in a file name cannot become message syntax.

unreachable.missing: {path} غير موجود. إذا كان على قرص قابل للإزالة أو مشاركة شبكية، فوصّلها ثم أعد المحاولة.

picker._comment_openFromFile: A button. The ellipsis means a file dialog opens, which is a convention worth keeping in every language that has it.
picker.openExisting: فتح خزنة موجودة بدلًا من ذلك
picker._comment_dialogTitle: The title bar of the operating system's file dialog. 'Remoter' is the product name.
picker._comment_vaultFilter: The name of the *.rvault file-type filter in that dialog.
picker.dialogFailed: لم يُفتح متصفح ملفات النظام، فلم يمكن اختيار خزنة بهذه الطريقة. والخزنات التي سبق أن فتحتها لا تزال مدرجة هنا.
picker._comment_recentsNote: PRIVACY. The list holds file paths only — no credentials and nothing from inside a vault. Do not weaken 'on this machine only'; it is the reassurance the sentence exists for.
picker.recentsNote: تُخزَّن مسارات الخزنات الأخيرة على هذا الجهاز فقط.
picker._comment_forget: Removes one vault from the recent list. It does NOT delete the vault file, and the wording must not suggest that it does.
picker.forgetFailed: لم تُزَل هذه الخزنة من القائمة.
picker._comment_neverOpened: Sits where a relative time — 'yesterday', '2 minutes ago' — would. Lower case, and a fragment rather than a sentence.
picker._comment_settings: The accessible name of the gear button in the title bar.
picker._comment_settingsHint: Its tooltip. It names the three settings worth changing before a vault is ever opened.

detail._comment_: The panel beside the list, describing whichever vault is under the pointer. It reads the cleartext header only.
detail._comment_unknownValue: Stands in for a figure that cannot be known yet — an em dash in English. A locale with its own convention for 'no value' may use it.
detail._comment_sealedCounts: Why the two counts above read as '—'. They are inside the encrypted body, which is not decrypted on this screen.
detail.sealedCounts: عددا الاتصالات وبيانات الاعتماد داخل المتن المشفّر. يظهران بمجرد فتح الخزنة.
detail._comment_backups: Copies of the vault file that Remoter writes beside it as it saves, oldest rotated out. Not the user's own backups.
detail.noBackups: لم تُكتب بعد أي نسخة احتياطية بجوار هذا الملف.
detail._comment_syncTitle: The vault sits in a folder that a cloud service synchronises. The body text under it is detail.syncWarning.
detail._comment_syncWarning: The body of the "In a synced folder" callout. {provider} is the cloud service's brand name (Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud Drive) and is never translated; it appears twice. SECURITY-RELEVANT: the second half says the provider keeps earlier copies of the encrypted file, so changing a password today does not retract yesterday's copies. Do not drop it.
detail.syncWarning: هذه الخزنة داخل مجلد {provider}. تعمل الخزنة، لكن تحريرها من جهازين في وقت واحد سيترك نسخة تعارض، كما يحتفظ {provider} بإصدارات سابقة من الملف المشفّر.

slotBadge._comment_: Tooltips on the small icons in a row of the list, saying which unlock methods that vault has. Read aloud by a screen reader, so each one is a full noun phrase rather than a word.

firstRun._comment_: What the launch screen says instead of a list when this machine has never opened a vault. 'Pick a vault' is a meaningless instruction when there are none, so it offers two doors.
firstRun.title: يحتاج Remoter إلى خزنة قبل أن يفعل أي شيء
firstRun.lede: الخزنة ملف واحد مشفّر يحمل اتصالاتك وبيانات اعتمادها. ويمكنك أن تملك عدة خزنات — واحدة للعمل وأخرى لعميل — وتُفتح على أي نظام تشغيل.
firstRun._comment_importTitle: The brighter of the two doors. Most people arriving here already keep their connections in another program.
firstRun._comment_importHelp: mRemoteNG, Royal TS and PuTTY are product names; ~/.ssh/config is a file path. None of them is translated.
firstRun.importHelp: يُنشئ خزنة أولًا. أما معالج الاستيراد من mRemoteNG و Royal TS و PuTTY و ~/.ssh/config فيأتي في إصدار لاحق، لذا فهذه في الوقت الحالي هي الخطوات الأربع نفسها التي تبدأ بها من خزنة فارغة.
firstRun.emptyHelp: أربع خطوات: أين يوجد الملف، وكلمة مرور رئيسية، وملف مفتاح اختياري، ثم مفتاح الاسترداد.

wizard._comment_: The frame around the four create-vault steps: title bar, the stepper, and the two footer buttons.
wizard._comment_stepOf: Shown at the right of the title bar. {step} and {total} are numbers, formatted in the locale's own numbering system.
wizard._comment_step1: The four stepper buttons. The numeral and the separator are part of the label; a locale may use a different separator, but keep the numeral so the step order is readable at a glance.
wizard._comment_stepBlocked: Tooltip on a stepper button for an earlier step that is not finished.
wizard._comment_stepAhead: Tooltip on a stepper button for a step the user has not reached yet.
wizard._comment_back: The button that returns to the previous step. A direction, not a verb of undoing.

create._comment_: Steps 1 to 3 of the create-vault wizard. Step 4 is the 'recovery' group below.
create.browseFailed: لم يُفتح مربع حوار ملفات النظام. اكتب المسار بدلًا من ذلك.

footNote._comment_: One line in the wizard's footer, saying what has and has not happened yet. Steps 1 and 2 share the first: nothing is written to disk until the end of step 3.
footNote.keyfileLater: يمكنك إضافة ملف مفتاح أو إزالته في أي وقت لاحق.

blocked._comment_: Why Continue will not respond, shown beside it. Each names the one thing to do next, in the order the user would do them.
blocked.name: أعطِ هذه الخزنة اسمًا.
blocked.folder: اختر المجلد الذي سيوجد فيه ملف الخزنة.
blocked._comment_strengthUnknown: The password strength verdict comes from the Rust core and is the gate on step 2. Until it answers there is no gate to pass, and this says so rather than letting the button look broken.
blocked.strengthUnknown: في انتظار تقييم النواة لهذه كلمة المرور. لا يمكن إنشاء شيء حتى تُجيب.
blocked.strength: ليست هذه كلمة المرور قوية بما يكفي بعد.
blocked.confirmation: التأكيد لا يطابق كلمة المرور بعد.
blocked.keyfileTarget: حدّد أين يُكتب ملف المفتاح المولَّد.
blocked.keyfileChoice: اختر ملف المفتاح الذي يجب أن تتطلبه هذه الخزنة.

location.title: أين يجب أن توجد الخزنة؟
location.lead: ملف واحد يحمل كل شيء. انسخه احتياطيًا كما تنسخ أي ملف لا تحتمل فقدانه.
location._comment_suggesting: The core is working out a default folder and file name. Shown for one round trip while the folder field is empty.
location.name: الاسم
location.nameHint: الاسم الذي تُعرف به هذه الخزنة في قائمة الاختيار وشريط العنوان.
location._comment_namePlaceholder: An example name in the empty field, not a value. Replace it with a plausible example in your language; keep it short enough to fit.
location._comment_pickFolder: The title bar of the operating system's folder-chooser.
location.suggestFailed: تعذّر على Remoter تحديد موقع افتراضي لهذه الخزنة، فحقل المجلد فارغ. اكتب مجلدًا أو استعرض للوصول إليه.
location._comment_syncTitle: {provider} is the name of a cloud storage service — Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud Drive. A product name: never translated, and wrapped in a Unicode isolate so it cannot reorder the sentence around it.
location._comment_syncBody: SECURITY-CRITICAL. The second half is the part that matters: a sync service keeps old versions of the encrypted file, so a copy protected by a password the user later changes stays retrievable from the provider. Do not shorten it away.
location.syncBody: سيعمل هذا. أمران ينبغي أن تعرفهما: التحرير من جهازين في الوقت نفسه سيُنتج نسخة متعارضة، و{provider} يحتفظ بإصدارات سابقة من الملف المشفّر — بما فيها إصدارات محمية بكلمة مرور تغيّرها أنت لاحقًا.
location.syncOnce: يُعرض مرة واحدة. لن تُسأل مرة أخرى عن هذه الخزنة.

password.title: اختر كلمة مرور رئيسية
password._comment_lead: 'Composition rules' means requirements like 'one capital, one digit, one symbol'. This application has none, deliberately.
password.lead: الطول يتفوق على الرموز. لا توجد هنا قواعد تركيب إلزامية لأنها تُنتج كلمات مرور أسوأ على نحو موثوق.
password._comment_reveal: A button beside the password field. A verb: it shows the characters that are currently hidden.
password._comment_hide: The same button once the characters are visible. A verb: it hides them again.
password._comment_bits: The estimated entropy of the typed password, beside a five-segment meter. '≈' is 'approximately'. A bit is the unit of information; keep the unit and pluralise it the way your language does.
password.bits: {count, plural, zero {≈ # بت} one {≈ بت واحد} two {≈ بتان} few {≈ # بتات} many {≈ # بتًا} other {≈ # بت}}
password._comment_notYet: Replaces the strength word — 'Weak', 'Fair', 'Strong' — while the password is below the bar. Those words come from the core.
password.tooWeakHelp: تحتاج الخزنة إلى أكثر من هذا بقليل. أضف كلمة أو كلمتين — فالطول هو ما يشتري الهامش، لا الرموز.
password.generateHint: كلمات عشوائية، بعدد يكفي لتجاوز الحد أعلاه
password.generateFailed: تعذّر على النواة توليد عبارة مرور. اكتب واحدة بنفسك.
password._comment_strengthFailed: The rating is not advice: it is the gate that lets the wizard continue, and it lives in the core. Say that the vault cannot be created rather than implying the password is bad.
password.strengthFailed: تعذّر على النواة تقييم كلمة المرور هذه، وبوابة القوة موجودة هناك لا هنا. وحتى تُجيب، لا يمكن إنشاء الخزنة.
password._comment_note: SECURITY-CRITICAL. Two facts that must survive translation: the password never leaves the machine, and forgetting it leaves only the recovery key. 'Step 4' is the last step of this wizard.
password.note: لا تغادر كلمة المرور هذه جهازك أبدًا ولا تُخزَّن أبدًا. يُشتق منها مفتاح يفكّ تغليف مفتاح الخزنة. وإن نسيتها، فلن يعيدك إلى الداخل إلا مفتاح الاسترداد من الخطوة 4.

keyfile.title: أضف ملف مفتاح
keyfile._comment_optional: A badge beside the heading. Lower case, one word.
keyfile._comment_lead: 'Something you know plus something you have' is the standard two-factor phrasing; use the established equivalent in your language if there is one.
keyfile.lead: عامل ثانٍ: أي ملف تختاره يصبح جزءًا من المفتاح. شيء تعرفه مع شيء تملكه.
keyfile.generateHint: ملف عشوائي بطول 256 بت يمكنك وضعه على ذاكرة USB
keyfile._comment_skipTitle: The third choice: no key file at all. A verb, addressed to the user.
keyfile.skipHint: كلمة مرور فقط. ويمكنك إضافة ملف مفتاح لاحقًا.
keyfile._comment_saveToHint: Shown only while the field is empty. It is permission, not instruction: any location works.
keyfile._comment_pickSave: The title bar of the operating system's save dialog.
keyfile._comment_pickExisting: The title bar of the operating system's open dialog.
keyfile._comment_sameFolder: SECURITY-CRITICAL. The key file has been put in the vault's own folder, which is allowed but defeats the point of a second factor. Say that it works and then why it stops being a second factor; do not turn it into a refusal.
keyfile.sameFolder: هذا الملف يقع بجوار الخزنة، فمن ينسخ أحدهما ينسخ الاثنين. سيعمل؛ لكنه يكفّ عن كونه عاملًا ثانيًا.
keyfile._comment_required: SECURITY-CRITICAL. Shown before the vault is created, once a key file has been chosen. Losing the file means losing the vault unless the recovery key survives.
keyfile.required: صار هذا الملف مطلوبًا لفتح الخزنة. وإن فقدته، فلن يعمل إلا مفتاح الاسترداد.

recovery._comment_: Step 4, and the same panel again when a recovery key is rotated from vault settings. The key is shown exactly once and is stored nowhere, which is why this screen makes the user retype part of it.
recovery.heading: مفتاح الاسترداد الخاص بك
recovery.lead: يُعرض مرة واحدة، الآن. وهو السبيل الوحيد للعودة إلى هذه الخزنة إن فقدت كلمة مرورك أو ملف مفتاحك.
recovery._comment_footNote: The wizard's footer line on this step. The vault already exists by the time this is on screen — say so, or the user reads the step as cancellable.
recovery.footNote: أُنشئت الخزنة بالفعل. وهذا المفتاح لا يُخزَّن في أي مكان ولن يُعرض مرة أخرى.
recovery._comment_nextLabel: The button that leaves this screen. It stays disabled until the nominated group has been retyped, so it can afford to be a sentence.
recovery._comment_copy: A verb on a button: put the key on the clipboard.
recovery.copyFailed: لم يسمح هذا النظام بالنسخ. اكتب المفتاح بخط اليد أو اطبعه بدلًا من ذلك.
recovery._comment_download: A verb on a button: save the key as a plain text file.
recovery.downloadFailed: لم يسمح هذا النظام بحفظ الملف. اطبع المفتاح بدلًا من ذلك.
recovery._comment_print: A verb on a button: send the key to a printer.
recovery.printFailed: لم يفتح هذا النظام مربع حوار الطباعة. انسخ المفتاح أو اكتبه بخط اليد بدلًا من ذلك.
recovery._comment_confirmPrompt: {group} is which group of the key to retype — a position, counting from one. The group itself is highlighted in the grid above. This is one sentence rather than a sentence assembled around a number: split sentences do not survive translation.
recovery.confirmPrompt: اكتب المجموعة رقم {group, number} — وهي المُظلَّلة — لتؤكد أنها عندك في مكان آمن.
recovery._comment_targetGroupAria: The accessible name of that highlighted group, read aloud instead of the four characters in it.
recovery.targetGroupAria: المجموعة رقم {group, number}، وهي التي عليك إعادة كتابتها
recovery._comment_remaining: How many characters are still missing from what has been typed. Counting down, so it is never zero.
recovery.remaining: {count, plural, zero {لم يبقَ شيء} one {بقي حرف واحد} two {بقي حرفان} few {بقيت # أحرف} many {بقي # حرفًا} other {بقي # حرف}}
recovery.mismatch: هذه ليست المجموعة المُظلَّلة. قارنها بالمفتاح أعلاه.
recovery._comment_warningTitle: SECURITY-CRITICAL. Verbatim from docs/security/vault-format.md. This is the sentence that stops someone clicking past the only copy of their recovery key. It must not be softened, hedged, or turned into a question.
recovery.warningTitle: هذا هو سبيلك الوحيد للعودة إلى الداخل.
recovery._comment_warningBody: SECURITY-CRITICAL. Every clause is load-bearing: not by you, not by us, not by anyone; no reset, no backup, no support override. A translation that leaves room for hope here causes the loss it is warning about.
recovery.warningBody: إذا فقدت كلمة مرورك الرئيسية ومفتاح الاسترداد هذا، فلن يمكن فتح خزنتك — لا أنت، ولا نحن، ولا أي أحد. لا توجد إعادة تعيين، ولا نسخة احتياطية، ولا تجاوز من الدعم الفني. احفظه في مكان تحفظ فيه جواز سفرك.
recovery._comment_brokenResult: SECURITY-CRITICAL. The vault exists but its recovery key cannot be displayed. Closing the application here loses the key permanently, so the instruction not to close comes before the explanation.
recovery.brokenResult: أعادت النواة مفتاح استرداد لا تستطيع هذه الشاشة عرضه. لا تغلق التطبيق: الخزنة موجودة، ومفتاح استردادها لم يُعرض بعد.

sheet._comment_: The printed and downloaded sheet. It is a document to be filed in a drawer, so it repeats the warning in full.
sheet.title: مفتاح استرداد Remoter
sheet._comment_vault: {path} is the vault's file path. Never translated.
sheet._comment_created: {date} is the day the vault was created, formatted for the locale.
sheet._comment_protection: {summary} is the key-derivation cost, e.g. 'Argon2id, 256 MiB, t=3'. Produced by the core and never translated.
sheet._comment_warning: SECURITY-CRITICAL. The two warning strings above, joined for the sheet. Keep them identical to what is on screen.

unlock._comment_: The unlock screen. It lists the slots this vault's header actually has, so a vault with one password slot shows one card and no invented alternatives.
unlock._comment_noSlots: The header parsed but names no method that can open it. That should not happen, and saying so is more useful than a generic failure.
unlock.noSlots: لا تذكر ترويسة هذه الخزنة أي طريقة صالحة لفتحها. لا يُفترض أن يحدث هذا؛ والأرجح أن الملف تالف.
unlock._comment_action: The primary button. A verb: open this vault now.
unlock._comment_deriving: The same button while the key is being derived. Short, because the idle label reserves the room for it; the full sentence is derivingStage.
unlock._comment_derivingStage: Beside the spinner. It names the stage rather than saying 'Unlocking…', because naming it is what makes the wait read as expected.
unlock._comment_noMethodSelected: A refusal that should be unreachable: the button is disabled until a method is chosen. It is translated because 'should be unreachable' is not 'is'.
unlock.noMethodSelected: لم تُحدَّد أي طريقة لفتح القفل.
unlock._comment_failed: SECURITY-CRITICAL. Shown whichever factor was wrong — password, key file, recovery key. It must NOT say which one, and must not be made more helpful: naming the factor tells an attacker which half they already have (docs/security/key-management.md).
unlock._comment_attempt: How many attempts have failed. Beside the message above.
unlock.attempt: {count, plural, zero {المحاولة #} one {المحاولة #} two {المحاولة #} few {المحاولة #} many {المحاولة #} other {المحاولة #}}
unlock._comment_attemptWaiting: The same count, plus the countdown the interface enforces before the next attempt. {attempt} is a number of attempts, {seconds} a number of seconds. 's' is the symbol for second and is not translated in languages that use it.
unlock.attemptWaiting: {attempt, plural, zero {المحاولة #} one {المحاولة #} two {المحاولة #} few {المحاولة #} many {المحاولة #} other {المحاولة #}} · {seconds, plural, zero {المحاولة التالية بعد # ثانية} one {المحاولة التالية بعد ثانية واحدة} two {المحاولة التالية بعد ثانيتين} few {المحاولة التالية بعد # ثوانٍ} many {المحاولة التالية بعد # ثانية} other {المحاولة التالية بعد # ثانية}}
unlock._comment_refused: The heading over any other failure the core reported. That failure's own sentence is shown beneath it, so this only has to frame it.
unlock.keyfileMissing: تحتاج هذه الفتحة إلى ملف مفتاحها أيضًا قبل أن تفتح القفل.
unlock._comment_keyfileDialogTitle: The title bar of the operating system's file dialog.
unlock._comment_keyfileDialogFailed: The last sentence matters: a failed dialog sent nothing anywhere, and no attempt was spent.
unlock.keyfileDialogFailed: لم يُفتح متصفح ملفات النظام، فلم يُختر أي ملف مفتاح. ولم يُرسل شيء إلى الخزنة.
unlock._comment_keyfileRemembered: PRIVACY-ADJACENT. The path of the key file this machine last used is remembered; the file's contents never leave the core. Offered back so the user is not left guessing which file it was.
unlock.keyfileRemembered: هذا هو ملف المفتاح الذي فتح به هذا الجهاز الخزنة آخر مرة. استعرض لاختيار ملف آخر.
unlock._comment_recoveryPlaceholder: The shape of a recovery key, shown in the empty field. Each X stands for one character of the key; the groups and the dashes are how it is written down.
unlock._comment_recoveryLastResort: A small label on the recovery-key card. It is the method to use when the others are gone, not one to prefer.
unlock._comment_fido2Fastest: A small label on the security-key card. Lower case: it is an aside, not a heading.
unlock.fido2Unavailable: تملك هذه الخزنة فتحة مفتاح أمان، لكن فتح القفل باللمس غير مُنفَّذ في هذا الإصدار. استخدم طريقة أخرى في الوقت الحالي.
unlock.keychainHelp: محفوظ في سلسلة مفاتيح النظام. لا شيء تكتبه — اضغط «فتح القفل».

blocked._comment_: Why the Unlock button will not respond, shown beside it and as its tooltip. Ordered the way the user would fix them: the thing to choose, then the thing to type, then the wait.
blocked.fido2: لا يمكن استخدام فتحة مفتاح الأمان في هذه الخزنة في هذا الإصدار.
blocked.keyfile: اختر ملف المفتاح الذي تحتاجه هذه الفتحة.
blocked._comment_backoff: The countdown after a failed attempt. {seconds} is a number of seconds; 's' is the symbol for second.
blocked.backoff: {seconds, plural, zero {الانتظار # ثانية قبل المحاولة التالية بعد محاولة فاشلة.} one {الانتظار ثانية واحدة قبل المحاولة التالية بعد محاولة فاشلة.} two {الانتظار ثانيتين قبل المحاولة التالية بعد محاولة فاشلة.} few {الانتظار # ثوانٍ قبل المحاولة التالية بعد محاولة فاشلة.} many {الانتظار # ثانية قبل المحاولة التالية بعد محاولة فاشلة.} other {الانتظار # ثانية قبل المحاولة التالية بعد محاولة فاشلة.}}

damaged._comment_: SECURITY-CRITICAL as a set. A slot unwrapped correctly and the body then failed to decrypt, which means the file changed after it was written. The user's credentials were right, and the copy must say so first — anything vaguer sends someone hunting for a typo they never made.
damaged.title: بيانات اعتمادك كانت صحيحة. الملف تالف.
damaged.body: فكّ Remoter تغليف فتحة مفتاحك بنجاح، ثم عجز عن فك تشفير متن الخزنة. وهذا يعني أن الملف تغيّر بعد كتابته — لا أنك كتبت شيئًا خطأً.
damaged._comment_backups: The heading over the rolling backups Remoter wrote beside the vault file. Not the user's own backups.
damaged.backups: النسخ الاحتياطية المتعاقبة على هذا الجهاز
damaged._comment_openNewest: The action on the newest backup, which is the one to try first. A verb.
damaged._comment_openOther: The same action on an older backup, where the row above already says 'instead'. A verb: open this file.
damaged.noBackups: لا توجد نسخ احتياطية متعاقبة بجوار هذا الملف. الطريق الوحيد للعودة هو نسخة من نسخك الاحتياطية الخاصة.
